reviews.text: Reframe. It takes too much time🤷🏼‍♀️

All AI-driven. I poured my heart out during the intake questions. Just to be met with, “We are sorry you feel this way. How can we help?” Or something like that. I was hoping for something that would actually look at my answers and think about them. Not a bot. But nope. BOT. This makes me legit angry, because it’s taking advantage of a vulnerable population.

ETA - I tried again. No better. 

Still AI driven, from what I can see. 

I am in therapy and have support. 

This does NOT go more than three questions deep. And it absolutely should. 

I am sure it’s good for some. But my brain needs more options. Sorry, not sorry.
DO NOT LIKE. too busy, confusing, high maintenance, time-consuming
Mrs Andre.. Reframe is a go to for me.
Scammy priorities. They’ll renew your free few day trial for a full year without warning, even though they hint it won’t auto-renew. They’re the reason everyone’s drinking

I’m more mindful. Reframe has helped me so much. I didn’t want to fully stop drinking, but I’m in much more control of how much and when I want to drink. Now, there’s some weeks I don’t have a glass of wine at all! Thank you for helping me be in control and not the other way around.
3 years later AF. You can’t unlearn what you learn which makes it so much easier to reduce alcohol. There is so much info. Also book club, creatives meeting, coaching, live meetings. It’s the best.

Very helpful resource. This has been an invaluable resource for developing more intentional habits and cutting back on alcohol. The app mostly works well, with a few occasional glitches with challenges and video playback. But there are a lot of useful resources and tools and the curriculum is really great.

Can’t delete app. This app is very good and has a lot of good science behind it. The problem is that when you’re done and want to delete it you have to give a reason and it won’t delete no matter what choice you make. I think that’s not right. So recommend for content but beware when you’re done.

Total scam. Attempted to take me for $100 without my permission. I truly wanted the help, but you let me down and NOW I have to worry about you stealing money from me I don’t have for using the app for 2 fking days.

informative + kind. this app is super helpful whether you want to drink less, take a break, or stop altogether. there are multiple types of support (should you want any) including chats and distraction games, and no bird pressuring you to participate all day. you can restart the counter at any time and, while i haven’t used them myself, licensed counselors and even medication options. highly recommend.

Wonderful support and community. I can’t say enough good things about this app. I really enjoy the science focused daily tasks that help you understand why it’s so hard to change your relationship with alcohol without any judgment or criticism. I also enjoy that there is both a cut back track to follow or an alcohol free track depending on what your personal goals are. You can even switch from one to the other once you have explored the app for a while, depending on your needs and results the community and forum, chats and posts are amazing and the people, from all over the world, who participate our supportive and kind to everyone else. The meetings that you can join and participate in whatever level you feel comfortable with are a huge help and a journey to change your relationship with alcohol. My only complaint about the app is that the iOS version has far more features than the android version. there are certain things I have to do on my iPad if I want to have access to them and even then not all information between the iPad and the account on my android phone.
scam. this was and is a very deceptive and misleading app that automatically blocks cancellation and refunds and charges you after you request a cancellation stay away from this company junk
Helped. 9/10

Kind of good. A bit disappointed that is has virtually no spiel for if you fall of the wagon. I was expecting some big motivational slide show on how I can redeem myself but I got nothing other than my drinks avoided dropping to zero which doesn’t even make much sense to begin with since it basically assumes I drink daily which I don’t as I only drink on weekends. More of an algorithmic anti drinking partner than a real anti drinking advocate not that it was ever meant to be a replacement for that but if you have a real issue certainly look elsewhere. 
This will not move the needle for you. Best of luck.
Overpriced Deceptive. All of my Apps give me a trial reminder before they charge you this did not. Also they did not charge me through Apple so I am not sure how I even got it. Refund my money
Waste of time. So incredibly disappointed
Seriously useful and helpful app. This app is so encompassing- really personalized and makes it feel interesting and … fun? 🤔 almost - to cut back on drinking. Very impressed.

Now I really want to drink. The app made it clear that it was easy to cancel before the free trial expired. I tried to cancel and they made it very difficult so I guess it didn’t get canceled and now they charged me $119. I have a wife and children and can’t afford this. Now I really wanna drink. I need this resolved and any help would be appreciated.
Garbage. Garbage

Best app ever. If you want to learn the science behind alcohol and get motivated to promote your overall health and well-being, then this App is for you. It’s for anyone that has enjoyed alcohol use so probably everyone in the United States.

Can’t even get started. Can’t even get started with this app. I tried creating an account, but after waiting over 30 minutes, I still never received the confirmation code. I checked my inbox, spam, and junk folders, and there was nothing.

I then attempted to contact support through the link provided, but when I hit “Send,” the page just kept refreshing and blinking back to itself without actually submitting my message.

Hard to evaluate the app when I can’t even get past the account setup process.

The app does not recognize stages of life. I am a highly educated, retired 67-year-old who is searching for purpose in my new retired life. Reframe completely ignores all aspects of my life, all of which impact drinking. It would be helpful if the app was more interactive and used AI to address generational and situational needs.

Good app. I have been using this app for 11 months. I like it a lot. However, I have reached out three times to support for various questions or app issues and they don’t respond. This is the reason for the 3 stars. Otherwise it’s a great app.

Life changing. For me, the biggest impact of this app has NOT been on my relationship with alcohol (that’s not to say that it has had none), the biggest impact has been on my happiness and relationship with myself and other. I didn’t realize I could be so happy with every day life before this app. It has truly changed my life - made me enjoy life more, feel good about myself, helped me improve my relationships with family and friends, and much more.

No one paid me to write this, and I’m not a bot. I’m a proud mommy, wife, daughter, rockstar employee, and so much more. I rarely review things, if that helps provide credibility to this review. 

I’ll end with a caution, only subscribe to this if you are ready to become a better you - if not, wait until you. 

Thank you reframe team from the bottom of my heart - not sure where I’d be without this (reframing - I’m so glad I found this app when I did)!

Can’t stop the notifications. Replace one addiction with another! This app will insist you attend to your phone constantly. Even with all but one notification set to off in the preferences, it’ll break through and alert you… about nothing! I only wanted one daily reminder, but it doesn’t care it’s going to pester all day long. Of course you can disable all notifications in your phones settings, but then you won’t get the one reminder you actually want.

I think it’s probably a good program, but its lack of respect for how I want to use it did me in. Not paying a subscription to be pestered.

Best Sober Lifestyle Tool. This app is the best tool to help anyone navigate themselves into a sober lifestyle! The daily check-ins and educational reads inspire you to make the choices for clarity & comfort while creating a sober lifestyle.
Life-changing. (Reframe), this is an amazing app and community. I would recommend it to anyone trying to come back with alcohol. The meetings are where it’s at. Total game changer.

Reframe Changed My Life!. Reframe truly works in a systematic way to help you navigate drinking and figure out what exactly works for you. I was in a really horrible place with drinking and I have had so much success finding myself without alcohol. 🥰

Take the 30 Day challenge. The Reframe App is the real deal if you want to cutback your alcohol consumption or stop drinking altogether. You have a choice to pursue either path but don’t have to commit to either as long as you keep working on the daily tasks which take 10-15 minutes each day. You get access to online Zoom meetings with people who are also working to reduce their alcohol consumption. Your participation in these meetings is not required, you can choose to speak or not speak, it’s up to you. There is a wealth of information each day, readings, videos, journaling, forum discussions, and meetings. One on one coaching with a real coach is available for an extra fee but the meetings are so interactive I have not chosen to have a one on one coach. I started off setting realistic goals to significantly reduce my alcohol consumption but within a few days was convinced by the information that Reframe provided regarding the health risks of drinking, that I should try going the alcohol free path for 30 days. What an amazing difference I’ve felt in my mental and physical health in the last 38 days. The 30 day free trial (actually costs $4.99) gives you access to all the benefits of the app that you need to move forward with less (or no) alcohol in your life. The app gives you ample advance notice that 30 days is approaching if you don’t want to proceed with the annual subscription of $99.99. There is minimal risk to trying this app but a big potential gain to your life and health. I can’t say enough good things about the app, it’s ease of use, the Reframe support team, the connection with real people and the great information that you receive. Give it a try for 30 days, you won’t regret it.

Scammers. They’ll bill you without a subscription. I paid for the first year. Then canceled months before renewal. Even the app shows “NO SUBSCRIPTION “, yet they try and charge my credit card every few days. There’s no one to talk to and they just keep charging my card. SCAM!!!!!

Overwhelmingly Unhelpful. I can only imagine that the devs have paid for 5 star user reviews. This app is atrocious and has too much going on. The UI/UX is abysmal and they’re constantly trying to upsell you in the app. AVOID unless you want this app to make you relapse.

Stopped using due to AI. This was moderately helpful for about a month, then I resented it like a chore. Ultimately deleted because you can’t opt out of AI features and I don’t want to give AI my sensitive health data (or anything for that matter(
Great app. Amazing app really easy to use really knowledgeable. I love it.
Unused and still charged me (never signed up for paid acct). I’m not using it and not willing to pay the $119.99 that it automatically charged rme. Remove the charge

Predatory Subscriptions. This app is completely worthless. There are many other resources that are free or cost much less. If you purchase this app they will automatically sign you up for a yearly subscription without telling you and continue you charge you yearly. 

Don’t do it. Find other help.

No customer service. I booked a therapy appointment and the therapist no showed. I have contacted their support email several times and they have not responded to reimburse. They don’t provide a phone number for customer support. Scam.

It works!. If you commit to just a short amount of time it takes to complete the daily tasks, it easily becomes a healthy habit. I relate to science and facts and logical thinking. The app touches on all aspects and gently adds the emotional aspects that tie into each lesson. Just the right amount of time commitment to not be so overwhelming. I come from a long line of family alcohol use disorders and I’ve learned so much! Finally feel hope that I’m on the road to permanent sobriety. Thank you reframe.

Reframe is saving grace🌻❤️. Reframe is a great platform. I have learned the impact alcohol has on our bodies, and how it is simply counterproductive.

I feel gratefulness for having found Reframe.

I have cancelled this before renewal but charges me anyways. Don’t trust them

630 days alcohol free. I am so glad I will never know if I could quit drinking without this app. I am 3 months shy of two years sober, this app is all you need besides the feeling that you are not comfortable with your relationship with alcohol. You will find community and support and understanding about Alcohol and our brains and body. I feel so lucky to have found it before I began my sober journey.

Outstanding platform. Thank you for making and supporting this program. Reframe has helped me quit drinking and I use it daily. I work a with sobriety coach and have hit >6 months sober.

Community. I value the community and coach support so much. The healing that comes from positivity and honesty has been an unexpected gift to my soul.

Life Changing!!. I have been a member of Reframe since Dec. 2021. This app has changed my life. While my journey has not been linear, Reframe has always offered the tools and options to help me in a non-judgmental, compassionate way. Everyone in the community is extremely supportive, and the Reframe administrative team has been exceptional at making sure this sense of acceptance and safety remains true at all times. I believe the biggest strength is that it is a science-based approach to what addiction really is. And you have a choice of paths- you can choose to be alcohol free or to mindfully moderat/cut back. This gives you the agency that so many of us need to actually affect change. And there is SOOO much to the app. The daily tasks include a robust set of short, information filled readings, followed by a thoughtful journal prompt that helps build your knowledge as you move through the process of changing your relationship with alcohol. It is filled with a plethora of other tools to provide support. The forum allows you to share your thoughts and experiences which are then supported by others. The multiple daily zoom meetings are incredibly powerful. There are tools to use when you have a craving, goal trackers, book and podcast recommendations, and the opportunity for personal coaching. There are monthly challenges that allow you to join with a small group of others to cheer and support one another. But I would say the most powerful/impactful thing about Reframe is that you have an entire toolbox and community of real supportive, compassionate friends in your pocket at all times. Some might balk at the cost, but if you truly calculate how much you spend on alcohol in a single month, Reframe is a bargain-- and will SAVE you money as you also improve both your physical health! They say the opposite of addiction is connection, and Reframe is THAT connection.

Great app. For anyone thinking about being AF this app has every possible option to do so and at your own pace.

Very helpful app. Highly suggest!. This app has helped me every step of the way to drink less and understand the FULL meaning of what alcohol does to you as a person and mainly how it affects your health

As a person who would drink everyday, this keeps me on target for my sobriety! ZERO drinks since I started!
Reinvented. Reframe helped me change my life.

Track your progress. This app, and my hard work, changed my life.

I think there are better options out there for sober apps.
They should tell you it costs money before doing the whole questionnaire. title

I am grateful to have found this app because it helps a lot. I don’t feel as guilty as I use to when I use to drink because I never knew that when it comes to quitting drinking that it’s hard and that support is the best thing. I know now that I can’t do this alone as much as I thought I could.

So Glad I Got This. Best thing I ever did for myself and my physical and mental health. Never thought I could find something that worked so well and was so supportive and informative!

Great Program. This is what you need to reach your goal of either curing back or not dinking. The people are awesome, the education is rich, and you will have the support you need to succeed.
So much value. I am impressed by all of the layers of this app. There is so much knowledge and support here it is an incredible value.

Remarkably Well Designed. I have been working in the field of addiction medicine for decades, and have been waiting for something like this to come out, not for my many patients, but for myself. The 12 steps of alcohol, alcoholics, anonymous, and other abstinence based programs are certainly effective… But they exclude anyone who simply wants to cut back. The combination of science activities encouraged reflection, and the design of this app is absolutely incredible. I cannot recommend it highly enough to clinicians whose clients struggle with overuse of alcohol and to anyone who would like to learn more drink less or quit completely in a way that honors science.

Doesn’t warn of subscription requirements. How nice of you guys to bring users through a long and detailed survey about their personal lives before you tell them an expensive, $120 subscription is required. Don’t try and BS with the monthly breakdown either, because it’s not like you let us cancel any month either.
Amazing!. This app is worth it! It has helped me so much. It’s holding me accountable. And the meetings are a game changer!

Excellent support to help you reach your goal. Reframe is an excellent tool to help you reach your sobriety goals. Every day they provide an article that combines elements of brain research, cognitive behavioral therapy and other psychological tools, along with motivational quotes and accountability check-ins at an affordable cost. They also allow a social connection to others on this journey within the comfort and privacy of your own home.

Don’t think this will help. It ain’t easy to quit. If this app tells you otherwise, question it. If you are willing to put in the months of hard work that is needed to quit, then you don’t need this app. Just my opinion. Do with it what you will.
Helping. Wonderful app and very useful

Saved my life. Best app for reducing and /or stopping alcohol use. The different challenges, forums, and resources are amazing!

Useful with some issues. I like the information the app presents. It’s educational, based on research, and easy to access. However, the checkin system and drink tracking leaves something to be desired. I would like it if my drink tracking was more in the moment, instead the app assumes you’re logging all of your drinks at one time, and the feedback it shares goes off of that instead of reality, where you may have a drink, then another, etc. I would like the app to be more here and now, provide reflections after you’ve logged it (ie the next day). Currently, I feel guilt if it’s like woot, you only had one drink despite reporting high stress. Yesterday you had four. Well, I’m not done, and now I’m gonna drink more. Versus, “wow, yesterday you logged 3 drinks one less than you have the past 7 days on average”. That’s success. It would also be helpful if logging the drinks were easier. Also, I think more education is needed on defining what a “drink” is.

I didn’t go into this thinking “I will now stop drinking forever.” But Reframe taught me to approach drinking with intention why am I doing this? What do I really want out of this moment? Is a glass of wine really just a glass of wine, or do I really want a friend, a nap, a compliment, or a snack? 

I enjoyed the mix of articles, video chats, journal entries etc. Give it a try you will learn something about alcohol and something about yourself.

I am now in a much better place with my drinking and therefore having a better relationship with myself and my friends/family. I feel better knowing reframe is there if I ever find myself wanting that support again. Get the app, do the challenges, do the work and you’ll thank yourself ❤️

Life Changing. This app really works and is life changing. It helped me cut back on alcohol 2 years ago and I’m back to use it to completely quit drinking. Wow. I can’t believe this app exists! It’s so worth the money and can definitely help me stop drinking

Love this app!. I love this app! I have recommended it to others and patients who want to be more mindful of their alcohol use too! Helps you to cultivate increased awareness and be more mindful of your drinking (or for those going the sober route too). Provides positive reinforcement with badges, great personalized insights and overall nothing negative to say about the app at all. Highly recommend!

It really is a great Reframe!. I’ve tried other apps and read/listened to many books. This app, although a bit pricey, has really helped in not only educating me on so many aspects associated with emotional, mental and physical health but also connecting with myself and others in a different light. This app moves along the journey with you without shame and with a deep understanding of what exactly I am going through based on MY daily check-ins. With the AI generated responses it’s so much more relatable and personalized to me and my lifestyle and situation. I’ve been tracking on Reframe for the month trial and decided to continue for the year because this app has been the most helpful of all the other apps/books etc that I’ve done. Do yourself a favor and at least try it for the free trial month. The app reminds you via email before the month is over so you can decide to continue or not before just getting hit with a charge at the end of the month. Good luck and happy Reframing!!

This is bs. Listen, I keep seeing this app suggested to me on a lot of platforms and thought I would check it out. If the creators really wanted to help people, it wouldn't cost $120 a year, it would be free. It's all algorithm based anyways. Absolutely ridiculous!

Great App, Limited Subscriptions. I really really enjoyed the app, however it is very limiting for there to be only one subscription option that costs over $100. I would have loved to continue for a bit longer for a month to month charge.

Saved my life more than once. Honestly, just an incredible level of being there when you really need it, in ways that matter. No platitudes or false promises, just meeting you where you are with straightforward, actionable truths. I’m very grateful for this app. I think it could help a lot of people like it did me.

Extremely Helpful. I have been using this app for almost 3 years. It has been so helpful to learn about the science of habit change and how the brain and body are affected by alcohol. That’s only the beginning of it, there’s a great drink and mood tracker, daily lessons, challenges each month, groups to join with others on the same path as you. Also coaching if you need to get extra support. I’m finally where I want to be with my drinking and I’ll continue to use this app for its support and great content that keeps being created.
very helpful and informative. been a great resource so far so convenient and wonderful hearing everybody’s stories and shares, even though I haven’t done that yet

The help I needed. This app has been the biggest influence on my sober journey. I actually look forward to checking in every day. I highly recommend for cutting back or going completely sober.

I didn’t subscribe for a second year but know I can go right back if I ever have a struggle again.

Helps with more than just drinking. Reframe is a great companion if you are looking to cut back or stop drinking all together, but it goes far beyond that.

Reframe does an incredible job at helping you understand your physical body, mind and more. I often communicated things I learned from the app to my therapist who was surprised at how creative and correct the information was.

If you are looking for an app to help you cutback on drinking or really any habit or are just looking to better yourself, Reframe is an incredible place to start!!

It’s just a great app that gives you all kinds of tools, support, and information that you can apply to your whole life. I would highly recommend it.

Definitely the most important app I have on my phone. I haven’t missed logging drinks since I got serious about cutting down my alcohol after my birthday this year. Extremely valuable information has been learned through this app that’s helped me navigate reducing my drinking. Overall this app has helped me reduce my alcohol intake by over 80%! If you’re serious about cutting back or cutting alcohol out completely, I would highly recommend this app. I haven’t used any of the coaches or listened to any of the webinars but I’m going to. I seriously think I owe my health to this app…my doctor thanks you too!

Best decision I ever made. I was struggling with alcohol my entire life. I knew I needed to stop but didn’t want to go to AA. I found Reframe and took it out for a free 7 day spin. By day 3 I committed to the year. I love the community it provides and all the support. This was exactly what I needed.

Life Altering Support. After a health scare and a particularly difficult death in my family, I chose to remove alcohol from my life. In terms of health, there wasn’t much of a choice. It was a necessity. I joined Reframe long before that and dabbled in dry months here and there, looked in on the app when curious about a damp lifestyle. After my decision to live without alcohol I have relied on Reframe for guidance, assistance in navigating an alcohol-free lifestyle, especially when so many around me drink regularly, and most importantly for support. It has been invaluable for me on my sober path.

Changed my life. Reframe has changed my life by changing my habits and educating me about my brain and neurotransmitters. This app has so many different components to support my journey. And I’m able to do it in the privacy of my home. I find myself looking forward to each day’s topic.
